_comment: Reference configuration for an Amazon Bedrock Guardrail. This is the shape of request you'd pass to bedrock.create_guardrail(). It filters both what goes IN to the model and what comes OUT.
name: aip-c01-content-safety-guardrail
description: Blocks unsafe topics, filters PII, and enforces word filters on both prompts and model responses.

topicPolicyConfig._comment: Denied topics — the model will refuse to engage with these regardless of how the question is phrased.

topicsConfig.name: MedicalAdvice
topicsConfig.definition: Requests for specific medical diagnosis, treatment, or dosage recommendations.
examples: What dose of ibuprofen should I take?
Do I have an infection based on these symptoms?

contentPolicyConfig._comment: Filters harmful content categories at graduated strength levels, checked on both input and output.

sensitiveInformationPolicyConfig._comment: Detects and masks PII in both directions — this is what protects users if a model tries to echo back sensitive data it was given or hallucinates a fake one.

wordPolicyConfig._comment: Simple exact-match word/phrase blocking — a blunt but fast first line of defense.

blockedInputMessaging: I can't help with that request.
blockedOutputsMessaging: I'm not able to share that information.
